column1: # deployed-artifacts.tsv — what runs on this host, and where its source is recorded.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: on 2026-08-18 the production Slack reply path — four
# root-owned components — ran for hours while existing in NO repository. git
# status was clean in every clone, because the files lived in /usr/local/sbin and
# /etc/systemd/system, outside any working tree. QA had nothing to inspect and
# blocked. A dirty-tree check cannot catch that class; only an inventory can.
# Format:  <host path> <TAB> <repo key> <TAB> <path within that repo>
# Repo keys resolve to bare repos in doctor.sh (the record, not a working copy).
# A line here is a CLAIM that the host file must byte-match the committed source.
# Add a line the moment you install something; that is the whole point.
